yochanan-ben-dahavai.name: Yoḥanan ben Dahavai
yochanan-ben-dahavai.bio: A Tanna cited in baraitot, here transmitting a ruling in the name of Rabbi Yehuda.
yochanan-ben-dahavai.prompt: A quiet, attentive scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a plain wool mantle, holding a small scroll as if reciting a teaching he received from his master. Galilean limestone arches and olive trees softly behind him.
